supervision.target_semantics: next received client-rendered root finite difference; local +X projected into Unity XZ
supervision.actor: local controlled actor only for regression; both actors for geometry audit
supervision.time: QPC seconds; bounded positive receipt deltas, no interpolation
supervision.units: Unity numeric distance units; metre calibration unverified; radians and seconds
supervision.command_semantics: client held-command/request context as observed at start; server acceptance and active move unknown
supervision.contact_context: recent received point-counter change is receipt context, never physical-contact truth
supervision.point_age: seconds since observed counter change, capped at 3; 3 also represents no change observed since capture start; pre-capture receipt history unknown
supervision.pose_context: root-relative ankle and wrist positions; support geometry does not prove floor contact
supervision.split: leave one process-clock-origin session group out; captures within 1000 ms origin grouped together
supervision.output_privacy: raw transitions and fitted diagnostic weights remain only in private output directory; Git report contains aggregates
supervision.model: fixed-lambda 0.01 standardized linear ridge predicts five root rates; no hyperparameter search
supervision.open_loop: replay recorded local command/request schedule; initialize measured root and finite-difference velocity once; hold start relative pose/opponent fixed; advance point receipt age without future receipts
limits: No server execution, contact normals, forces, motor state, support-contact truth, or active clip identity.
Root persistence is an explicit diagnostic baseline, not a replay of the full native5 simulator.
Process groups use stable UTC minus Unity unscaled time; direct game PID is absent from the policy stream.
High-tilt proxy windows are observational matches and do not identify causal attack/fall outcomes.
Future command replay is conditional prediction, not a new-policy counterfactual rollout.
Open-loop compact pose and opponent context are frozen; this is not a complete coupled-body simulator.
